sources.title: Android InstallSourceInfo
sources.scope: Installer identifiers may be unavailable or changed; their presence is not attestation. Collector uses older PackageManager API and maps null to manual.

sources.title: Android NetworkCapabilities
sources.scope: Transport flags describe a network observation. Collector-specific API 23 gate and fallback semantics come from local Kotlin source.

sources.title: Android WebSettings user agent
sources.scope: User agent can be overridden. Marker inspection is lexical context and is not proof of container identity.
